newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling gains as investors leave Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling gains as investors leave Kenya.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling strengthened against the dollar and pound on Wednesday as investors pulled out of neighbouring Kenya.
The shilling traded at a commercial mean rate of 621.0468 to the dollar compared to Tuesday's rate of 624.6603. Against the pound, it stood at 1009.2042 from 1019.2279 on Tuesday.

Financial analysts said the shilling's strength was partly due to capital inflow into Tanzania from investors in Kenya alarmed at the International Monetary Fund's halting a key loan package last Thursday.
Kenya's central bank appealed for calm on Nairobi's foreign exchange market on Wednesday and intervened to stem a Kenyan shilling slide against the dollar as the currency stayed under pressure.
The Kenyan shilling has depreciated by some 12.6 percent since news broke on Friday of the IMF's stopping its loan package.
